source: Actual guarded disposable Windows Sandbox editor recordings, synthetic PNG only
clocks: Precise paired FILETIME/QPC sender anchors and decoded epoch capture PTS, all original timings retained.
speed: Real time, 1x. The manifest gives phase offsets, not retiming.

video.timing_limit: Actual capture PTS and duplicate analysis govern timing claims, not requested FPS

runs.timing_warning: Container timestamps are absolute epoch values. Normalize with setpts=PTS-STARTPTS; do not infer duration from format.duration or speed up the recording.
runs.scope: Actual standalone editor. Native uses unchanged production HWND renderer in a guarded harness; ShareX22 is the unmodified stock app via -portable -ImageEditor.
runs.overlay_policy: A neutral ring may represent these actual sender coordinates if labeled Recorded input position; it is not a captured application cursor.

analysis.scope: Video-sampled annotation progress, not physical display latency or a claim of UI render FPS.
analysis.timing: Epoch GDI capture PTS aligned with paired precise FILETIME/QPC anchor. Each sample includes observer acquisition and sampling delay.
analysis.uncertainty: At least one observed capture interval plus pixel localization/injection jitter. Negative or ambiguous samples are retained and flagged, not silently clamped.
analysis.red_predicate: R>170,G<100,B<100, baseline subtraction, trajectory ROI excludes app toolbar
analysis.metric_status: Video-sampled estimates, subject to the stated observer and localization uncertainty.
